game.title: Fenomeno · Pacific Coast Highway
game.pitch: 1:1-scale drive down Highway 1 from San Francisco to San Diego. Twelve legs, named coastal places, drift-to-charge boost, optional 6-car races. Browser only — no download.
game.controls: WASD drive · Space handbrake · C camera · R re-seat · P / Esc pause · on-screen SUN slider for time of day
game.route: San Francisco → Pacifica → Half Moon Bay → Santa Cruz → Big Sur → San Luis Obispo → Santa Barbara → Malibu → Santa Monica → San Diego (627 miles)

crazygames.note: Portal login is required. This agent cannot finish the upload.

tagline.en: 1:1-scale Highway 1 from San Francisco to San Diego. Drift to charge, race the field, chase the sun.
tagline.zh: 1:1 比例太平洋一号公路：旧金山开到圣地亚哥。漂移充能、编队竞速、追着太阳跑。
